observations: Standing hooded hair dryer on a five-legged wheeled base.
Control panel on top features two rotary knobs and one rocker switch.
The hood is grey/silver with a black internal grill protecting the heating elements.
The item is shown in a cluttered indoor setting.
Photos 0, 1, and 2 are very similar front-facing shots of the same unit.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI OTANIYEN EGBON' is visible across the center of the images.

claims.evidence: There is no visible manufacturing label or plug type shown to confirm origin.
No video or photo shows the device powered on or functioning.

risks.risk: The heating element may be burnt out or disconnected.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit running and generating heat (e.g., using a thermometer or showing the element glowing if applicable).

risks.risk: The fan motor may be seized, noisy, or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video with sound showing the fan spinning at various speeds.

risks.risk: The height adjustment mechanism or the wheeled base may be damaged or stuck.
risks.proof: A video showing the stand being adjusted in height and the unit being rolled on the floor.

proof_requests: Video of the hair dryer plugged in and operating, demonstrating both the fan and the heat settings.
Clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate or sticker, usually found on the back or underside of the hood.
Photo of the power plug to verify compatibility and origin.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by type as a salon-style hooded hair dryer. Since no brand is legible and functionality is unproven, it is priced at the worst-case value for a non-functional generic unit.
